title: Cognizant GenC Next style · Aptitude + Coding
description: Aptitude plus two coding problems. 30 MCQs + 2 coding problems in 100 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text:
Study the table and answer.

Year | Produced (units) | Sold (units)
2021 | 290 | 225
2022 | 390 | 355
2023 | 340 | 330
2024 | 220 | 155
2025 | 390 | 335

In 2023, what percentage of the units produced was sold? (to 2 decimal places)
A sum of money amounts to Rs 22400 in 4 years at 10% per annum simple interest. What is the sum?
Rs 4000 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 5 : 3 : 8. What is B's share?
A bag has 3 red, 4 blue and 5 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that both are red?
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be after 106 days?
questions.explanation: 106 mod 7 = 1; Wednesday + 1 day = Thursday.

questions.text: The price of an item is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 5%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 25/100)(1 - 5/100) = 19/16, so the change is 75/4%: a 75/4% increase.

questions.text: What is 18% of 750?
If today is Friday, what day of the week will it be after 299 days?
questions.explanation: 299 mod 7 = 5; Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

questions.text: A trader marks his goods 20% above the cost price and then allows a discount of 20%. What is his gain or loss percent?
questions.explanation: SP as a fraction of CP = 6/5 × 4/5 = 24/25, so 4% loss.

questions.text: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 5:4. After 5 years, the ratio will be 50:41. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 5x and 4x. (5x+5)/(4x+5) = 50/41 gives x = 9; A = 45.

questions.text: The average age of 5 students is 38 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average increases by 1 year. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: New total = 39 × 6 = 234; old total = 190; teacher = 44.

questions.text: A sum of money amounts to Rs 17980 in 3 years at 8% per annum simple interest. What is the sum?
What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 7:20?
What are the roots of x² - 8x + 15 = 0?
questions.explanation: Sum of roots = 8, product = 15: the roots are 3 and 5.

questions.text: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 4:3. After 10 years, the ratio will be 6:5. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. (4x+10)/(3x+10) = 6/5 gives x = 5; A = 20.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: squares of 2, 3, ... plus 1. Next term = 50.
The rule is n → n²; for 4 it gives 16.

questions.text: Introducing a woman, Meera says, "She is the wife of the only son of my father." How is the woman related to Meera?
questions.explanation: The only son of Meera's father is Meera, so she is Meera's wife.

questions.text: A man is facing South. He turns about, then turns left, then turns right, then turns right. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: East.

questions.text: In a survey, 58 people read newspaper A, 45 read B, 27 read both and 3 read neither. How many people read only one newspaper?
questions.explanation: Only A = 31, only B = 18; total = 49.
The rule is n → n² + n; for 9 it gives 90.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 3, 11, 35, 107, 323, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: multiply by 3 and add 2. Next term = 971.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 49, 124, 100, 121?
questions.explanation: 124 — all others are perfect squares.

questions.text: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 27 identical small cubes. How many small cubes have no faces painted?
questions.explanation: For an n×n×n cube (n = 3): 3 faces: 8, 2 faces: 12(n−2), 1 face: 6(n−2)², none: (n−2)³ → 1.

questions.text: What comes next: FU, HS, JQ, LO, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +2; second letters move −2 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: In a certain code, JACKET is written as MDFNHW. How is NATURE written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +3 places in the alphabet.

questions.text: A man is facing North. He turns right, then turns about. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: West.

questions.text:
Statements: All pens are chairs. All pens are flowers.
Conclusion: Some chairs are flowers.
Does the conclusion follow?
questions.explanation: Draw the Venn diagram for the statements: the conclusion must hold in every possible case.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 16, 43, 20, 39, 24, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: two series alternate: +4 on odd positions, −4 on even positions. Next term = 35.

questions.text: Tarun is taller than Isha. Jatin is taller than Uma. Uma is taller than Tarun. Isha is taller than Varun. Who is the third tallest?
questions.explanation: Chaining the clues: Jatin > Uma > Tarun > Isha > Varun. The third tallest is Tarun.

questions.title: Number of islands
questions.text:
A grid has land (1) and water (0). Cells connect up, down, left and right. Print the number of islands.

Input: first line r and c (1 ≤ r, c ≤ 500); then r lines, each a string of c characters 0/1.
Output: the number of islands.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here

questions.explanation: Reference approach: see the standard technique for ‘Number of islands’.

questions.title: Anagram groups
questions.text:
Given n words, print how many groups of anagrams there are (words with the same letters in any order are in one group).

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^4); then n words of lowercase letters, each up to 20 letters.
Output: the number of groups.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here
